scope: Static parser, execution table, plugin manifest commands/aliases (including hidden) and all parent namespaces. Handler identifiers refer to packages/cli/src/runtime/built_in_commands.rs and dispatch.rs; schema identifiers to packages/cli-schema/src/lib.rs. Structural audit, not a runtime transcript waiver.

reasons.attach: Neutral local terminal entry point must survive the absence of Sessions. See INVARIANTS.md: Baseline operation survives missing domain plugins.
reasons.config: Read, inspect or change the configuration that selects plugins and their execution environment. See docs/development/cli-bootstrap-boundary.md: config.
reasons.device-seal-broker: Pane launcher invokes the current executable as an opaque stdin/stdout credential broker; this is not an interactive domain command. See docs/development/cli-bootstrap-boundary.md: SSHENV_DEVICE_SEAL_COMMAND.
reasons.doctor: Inspect a broken installation without requiring the plugin being diagnosed. Hosted checks remain a boundary to review; see packages/cli/src/runtime/doctor_cli.rs.
reasons.slot: Select or repair an executable and its environment before loading its plugins. See docs/development/cli-bootstrap-boundary.md: slot and env.
reasons.logs: Recover logging configuration/path without requiring the optional log viewer. See packages/cli/src/runtime/logs_cli.rs.
reasons.terminal: Probe the terminal and its terminfo installation even when optional UX plugins are missing. See packages/cli/src/runtime/terminal_doctor.rs.
reasons.keymap: Inspect effective input mapping independently of optional command/decoration plugins. See packages/cli/src/runtime/terminal_doctor.rs.
reasons.sandbox: Provision, inspect or recover an isolated runtime independently of its installed domain owners. See docs/development/cli-bootstrap-boundary.md: sandbox.
reasons.server: Launch, stop or inspect the server that hosts plugin execution. See docs/development/cli-bootstrap-boundary.md: server lifecycle.
reasons.autostart: Install or repair the service-manager entry before any server/plugin runtime exists. See packages/cli/src/runtime/server_autostart.rs.
reasons.bridge: The SSH transport invokes this binary over stdio; preserve preflight and protocol stdout. See docs/development/cli-bootstrap-boundary.md: server bridge.
reasons.gateway: Retained gateway process/transport launcher, not proof of client authorization. Host policy remains subject to the boundary in docs/development/cli-command-ownership-audit.md.
reasons.plugin: Manifest declares the native plugin command or alias. Exposure does not imply activation or authorize a core fallback.
reasons.namespace: Dispatch-only prefix composed from the child owners; do not transfer a whole mixed namespace to one plugin.
reasons.hidden: Manifest command is not exposed in the CLI. Do not turn an internal binding into a public leaf.
reasons.migration: Domain behavior belongs to the declared plugin; no parallel static leaf or proxy to the removed handler. See docs/development/cli-command-ownership-audit.md.
